name: mean-stack-admission-system
description: MEAN Stack POC Lab Assignment (PCCCS504) - Online Admission System

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.package: py -c "import zipfile, os; base='.'; zip_p='admission-system-submission.zip'; exc_d={'node_modules','.git','.cache'}; exc_f={'.env',zip_p}; zipf=zipfile.ZipFile(zip_p,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED); [zipf.write(os.path.join(r,f), os.path.join('admission-system',os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r,f),base))) for r,d,fs in os.walk(base) for f in fs if not d.intersection(exc_d) and f not in exc_f and not f.endswith('.zip')]; print('Created', zip_p)"

author: PCCCS504 Student
